entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Could I please get your full name and order number?
Of course. It's Sarah Miller, order number 774-VF-9821.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. That makes it about 35 days ago.
Yes, I know it's been a little while. I've been trying to make it work, I really have. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time.
We appreciate your loyalty, Sarah. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just... it's so **hard to use**. I find the menu system really **confusing**, and the **user manual** wasn't much help. Honestly, I just **expected more** from it. With money being tight, I feel terrible that I spent this much on something I can't even figure out. I really needed this money back.
I understand your frustration completely. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for that item. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you.

Alright, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I've just pulled up our policy, and it looks like all our items have a 90-day return window. Since you're only at day 35, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That is such a relief! Thank you so, so much, Alex.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. When should I expect the refund?
Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Wonderful. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
